title: Sonny and the Fog | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka walks into a patch of fog that has settled in the bush valley and discovers that inside it, the whole world becomes soft and close and wonderfully small. A gentle bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
The fog was just ahead.

Sunny could see it from the top of the small rise — a soft white mass that had settled into the hollow below, filling it entirely. From up here it looked like someone had poured milk into the valley.

She walked down into it.

It happened gradually. The edges first — wisps of cool, damp air around her paws and ankles. Then more, rising to her belly, her chest. Then all at once she was inside it.

The world shrank.

Everything beyond three steps disappeared. The trees ahead became shapes, then suggestions, then nothing. The moonlight was still there — diffused through the fog, it seemed to come from everywhere at once, a soft all-over glow with no source and no shadow.

She stopped and turned in a slow circle.

She was in the middle of a small, soft, glowing world. Just her. Just this pale circle of visible ground. Just the fog, close and kind, like being inside a cloud.

Everything sound was muffled. Even the crickets seemed far away.

She breathed in. The fog tasted of water and earth and cold air.

She walked a few steps further, into the deepest part.

She sat down in the middle of her soft white world.

The fog wrapped around her, close and quiet.

She could not see far. She did not need to.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, fog. Goodnight, little one.
